Licence notices for the LaTeX packages added to tex/tex_files.tar.gz (tikz-kit parcel E2).

Every package below is distributed under the LaTeX Project Public License (LPPL); the licence text is in LICENSE-LPPL.txt beside this file.
Each file in the archive is the author's file, unmodified; the SHA-256 of each is pinned in tikz-kit/build/PINS.md and
tikz-kit/build/extra-packages.mjs. Below, for each file, are its source and the licence lines it carries (copied from the file).
tikz-uml is not on CTAN: the file comes from its author's GitLab at tag v1.1. Version 1.0 of that package states no licence and is not used.
